text:
sophie_marketing: Drafting a compact follow-up one-pager for the webinar 1 'Compliance Fastlane' 1 target: regulated buyers who need clear SLAs and private deployment options. Will include 3 ad copy variants + routing rules.

ben_growth: Nice name. For paid acquisition let's run 3 CTAs: 'Schedule a compliance review', 'Show SLA options', 'Private demo (VPC)'. Rotate evenly for first month and measure demo-quality conversion.

kevin_sales: For handoff please include a 1-line summary for AEs: recommended intro, 3 quick objections & counters, and a pricing band. Also flag: any lead with 'gov' OR 'audit' OR 'HIPAA' should create enterprise lead.

omar_ops: Routing suggestion: keyword scan + form checkbox -> queue: enterprise-sdr. Scoring: if ARR_est > 120k OR compliance_level in [HIPAA, PCI, FedRAMP] -> auto-assign to AE. I'll add webhook and mapping.

anya_prod: Benchmarks to include (anonymized): 'Large insurer pilot: 8k context, p99 ~110ms on reserved private pool; cached prefixes reduced token spend by ~35%.' Also add note: hosted shared pools have wider variance (p99 ~180-300ms).

lucy_content: I'll write the three micro-copy voices: 1) 'Compliance-first' (tight, trust tone), 2) 'Speed-first' (latency + performance), 3) 'Assured-cost' (savings + predictable pricing). Each will be a 90-char headline + one-line subhead.

ben_growth: For social assets we should test short forms: 20-30 char headline + 2-line explainer. Put UTM templates in the doc.

kevin_sales: Handoff checklist request: PDF one-pager, AE note, routing webhook snippet, recommended demo slides (3), and a short legal-safe SLA blurb.

legal_bot: Quick legal note: use 'target SLA' language for hosted tiers. Only contractual SLA commitments can be promised for Dedicated/Private contracts. Avoid absolute latency claims for shared-hosted.

omar_ops: Webhook example for internal routing (please use HTTPS and auth header):

POST https://hooks.redwood/internal-leads
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>
{
  "company": "<company>",
  "email": "<contact_email>",
  "tags": ["<tags_comma_separated>"],
  "estimated_arr": "<numeric>",
  "compliance_flags": ["HIPAA|PCI|FedRAMP|SOX"],
  "source": "webinar_followup|paid_cta|social_click"
}

kevin_sales: Also include a short JSON mapping snippet for the router so AEs can inspect: 

# pseudo-config
"rule": "match(tags, /gov|health|finserv|audit/i) -> queue enterprise-sdr",
"priority": "score>120000 -> assign AE"

lucy_content: Draft micro-copy variants (HEADLINE - SUBHEAD):
1) Compliance-first - "Control your keys, control your data." - "Private Pods, HSM integration, and auditable logs for regulated teams."
2) Speed-first - "Private inference, sub-150ms p99 for long context." - "Dedicated pools tuned for low-latency, burst isolation, and consistent throughput."
3) Assured-cost - "Predictable costs for mission-critical apps." - "Reserved capacity and caching strategies to cut token spend and stabilize pricing."

anya_prod: Add decision guidance: WHEN TO RECOMMEND PRIVATE VS DEDICATED VS HOSTED:
- Private Pod: required KMS-only control, strict data residency, audited SLAs.
- Dedicated: strict performance SLOs with contract, shared infra isolation.
- Hosted: fastest onboarding, lower commitment, higher latency variance.

ben_growth: I'll prep UTMs: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=compliance_fastlane, utm_content={cta_variant}.

kevin_sales: Can we bake in an AE one-liner: 'If they ask about SLAs: "We offer contractual uptime and availability for Dedicated/Private contracts; hosted is offered as best-effort with published targets."' Legal ok?

legal_bot: Fine, as long as we specify which tiers are contractual and we don't publish hard latency numbers for hosted.

omar_ops: Timeline: content + one-pager draft today, routing + webhook test by EOD, legal sign-off tomorrow morning, paid A/B launch Thursday.

sophie_marketing: Great. I'll assemble the one-pager template with editable benchmark box and upload to Drive. Tagging @kevin_sales when ready for AE assets. Anything else?
